paragraphs.paragraph_text: A limited number of suppliers provide certain critical components. Replacing these suppliers may require time and significant expense. During the current reporting period, we have observed longer lead times and less predictable supplier capacity, which may increase working-capital requirements.
Evolving data protection, competition, and product-safety requirements may require substantial changes to our business practices.
Demand may be affected by macroeconomic conditions, customer budgets, product cycles, and the availability of competing products.
If we cannot pass increased costs to customers, our operating margins and cash flow could be adversely affected.

Management continues to monitor revenue growth, operating expenses, working capital, and capital allocation. Results may be affected by customer demand, product mix, foreign exchange movements, and changes in the cost of operations. These statements are illustrative synthetic content created for software testing and are not extracted from an actual filing.
